overview:
Bobby Scott, a long-serving Democratic incumbent, is seeking re-election in a Virginia district that leans Democratic by 18 points. He has raised nearly $700,000 and holds a substantial cash advantage, while Republican Edwin Rivera has raised only a few thousand dollars. Two independent candidates are on the ballot but show little financial activity.

No public polls or expert ratings cover this race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, the incumbency advantage, and the lopsided fundraising gap. Prediction markets price a Democratic win at roughly 95%. The seat is rated Safe Democratic, with Scott expected to win by a wide margin.
